programme.title: You Gotta Believe
programme.desc: A group of baseball players are having the most important season of their lives.For one of the boys, the stakes are even higher - the team fights not only for victories, but also for his father's dream to come true.

programme.title: How to Train Your Dragon 2
programme.desc: Five years have passed since the truce between the Vikings from the island of Berk and the dragons.The chief's young son, Hiccup, who tamed the first winged creature, Toothless, accidentally ends up with him in an unusual ice cave.There are many wild dragons living there and a mysterious rider who - like the Vikings from Berk - can control fire-breathing creatures.Hiccup is surprised to discover the identity of the mysterious figure... Soon, he learns about the plans of the ruthless Drago, who intends to subdue all dragons.His emissaries organize hunts for them.They also target the winged inhabitants of Berk.Hiccup, Toothless and their friends must fight... Continuation of the fate of the heroes of the first part of the 2010 film.The Polish language version of the film features, among others:Grzegorz Drojewski, Danuta Stenka and Julia Kamińska.

programme.title: The Fountain
programme.desc: Three stories about man's pursuit of immortality.16th century.In the forests of South America, Spanish conquistador Tomas Creo (Hugh Jackman), head over heels in love with Queen Isabella I of Castile (Rachel Weisz), is looking for the legendary tree of life for her.The ruler wants to use them to finally solve the problem of the power struggle with a certain high-ranking cardinal.In the 20th century, scientist Tom Creo (Hugh Jackman) tries to find a cure that will save his seriously ill wife Izzi (Rachel Weisz).A man cannot come to terms with the fact that his beloved is dying.He decides to devote himself to finding a way to overcome death.Six centuries later, astronaut Tommy (Hugh Jackman) travels through space in a glass ball.He wants to reach the golden nebula, hoping to bring Izzi back to life.A science-fiction drama by Darren Aronofsky, author of "Requiem for a Dream", "Black Swan" and "The Wrestler".

programme.title: Blue Moon
programme.desc: The year is 1943. The legendary lyricist Lorenz Hart (Ethan Hawke), co-author of such hits as "Blue Moon" and "My Funny Valentine", spends the night from March 31 to April 1 in Sardi's bar.In the company of friends, including his muse Elizabeth Weiland (Margaret Qualley), he struggles with wounded pride and shaken self-confidence.At this time, his former long-time collaborator Richard Rodgers (Andrew Scott) celebrates the premiere of his musical entitled"Oklahoma!", which he wrote with Oscar Hammerstein II (Simon Delaney).Two Oscar nominations.

programme.title: The Dark Wizard
programme.desc: Biography of the legendary climber, BASE jumper and slackliner.Dean Potter specialized in free solo ascents, speed climbing and slacklining without belays.An important element of his activity was crossing the boundaries of style and combining disciplines: climbing, highline and BASE jumping.He was the precursor of free BASE, i.e. solo climbing using a parachute as the only protection.In Yosemite he set speed and free solo records.His activities had a significant impact on setting risk limits, which raised ethical controversies in the community.He died in 2015 in Yosemite Valley.

programme.title: One, two, three... You're in the game
programme.desc: Salem, Massachusetts, a town marked by a history of witch hunts.Jonah (Benjamin Evan Ainsworth) and his older brother Marcus (Asa Butterfield) come across an abandoned cabin while biking through the forest.They find a diary and a knife with a mysterious inscription on its blade.When read to her, it evokes a demon that forces young people to participate in macabre versions of children's games - from hide and seek to tag.The brothers, their sister Billy (Natalia Dyer) and her friends take part in the bloody showdown.They discover that this competition from hell cannot be won.

programme.title: Babygirl
programme.desc: Romy (Nicole Kidman) leads a stable and prosperous life.She manages a modern, dynamically developing company, lives in a comfortable house with her devoted husband Jacob (Antonio Banderas) and two teenage daughters.Her everyday life changes when a young intern, Samuel (Harris Dickinson), appears.Despite the age difference, Romy and Samuel begin a fiery romance.The woman begins to rediscover herself, although this decision may mean the loss of both her professional position and her family.She is faced with the decision of whether to follow her own desires, risking everything she has achieved so far.

programme.title: Alita: Battle Angel
programme.desc: Alita (Rosa Salazar), a cyborg girl, wakes up from a coma.It turns out that he doesn't remember who he is or where he is.Doctor Ido (Christoph Waltz) subjected her to a series of tests that revealed that she was a young woman with a unique story.Wanting to protect her, he does not reveal the truth about her past.Alita must adapt to the conditions and rules of life in Scrap City.After some time, he regains his memory thanks to the help of his friend, Hugo (Keean Johnson).Then he realizes that he has incredible fighting skills.She must use them against the power that tries to control her.The film's director is Robert Rodriguez, known from "From Dusk Till Dawn" and "Machete".The script was written by the winner of three Oscars, James Cameron, who considered making "Alita" back in the 1990s. The film was based on the manga.

programme.title: Goodbye, Christopher Robin
programme.desc: End of World War I.A.A.Milne (Domhnall Gleeson) moves to the countryside with his family and, finding inspiration in the toys of his son Christopher Robin (Will Tilston), creates a story about the adventures of Winnie the Pooh, who will soon become a children's favorite.However, the quickly achieved international success is not only about profits.The price of A.A.'s fameMilne will suffer not only himself, but also his wife Daphne (Margot Robbie), their son and his caregiver Olive (Kelly Macdonald).The moving film with biographical elements received a BIFA nomination for best supporting actress - Kelly Macdonald.The music composed by Carter Burwell was appreciated by the World Academy of Film Music.

programme.title: The Emoji Movie
programme.desc: Millions of smartphones around the world have an application for sending messages through which you can communicate your feelings and moods.This is where the city of Textopolis, where emotes live, is hidden.The task of each of them is to express a different state of mind.The exception is Minek, who can express every emotion.However, he dreams of being like others.Together with Piątek and the superhacker Matrix, they set off on a journey through the phone in search of a solution.The animated film is directed by Tony Leondis ("Kung Fu Panda: Secrets of the Masters").The Polish language version featured, among others: Paweł Ciołkosz, Szymon Roszak, Monika Pikuła and Katarzyna Kwiatkowska.

programme.title: Oscar's Eye
programme.desc: Nine-year-old Oscar cannot speak.Because of this, he is rejected and bullied by his peers.However, he becomes friends with the owner of the workshop, Erik, with whom he shares a common passion - photography.

programme.title: The Book of Life
programme.desc: Two powerful magicians bet whether people are pure in heart.La Muerte is the ruler of the World of the Remembered.The dead stay there, remaining in the hearts of their loved ones.Xibalba rules the Land of the Forgotten - a sad place for souls that no one remembers.The magicians are tested by: fashion matador Manolo, who dreams of being a musician, and Joaquin - an athlete and the pride of the city.The boys compete for the affections of Maria, the daughter of the local mayor.However, the beautiful bride is resistant to their advances.Manolo and Joaquin will go on a wonderful journey, during which they will visit extraordinary lands, meet colorful characters and discover the truth about themselves.The project by Guillermo del Toro and Jorge R. Gutierrez was nominated for a Golden Globe in the category of best animated film.

programme.title: Focus
programme.desc: Nicky Spurgeon is a calculating fraud.The model's appearance and ability to keep cool make him a master criminal.He is able to win people over, but he does it to take advantage of them.One day, in a restaurant, he meets a fair-haired beauty, Jess Barrett, whose ambition is to pursue a criminal career.He becomes her mentor.Over time, they both realize that they have much more in common than the relationship of master and disciple.However, they live in a world where there is no place for love.Spurgeon ends this relationship.Three years pass.Nicky is in Buenos Aires, where he works for the owner of a car racing team, Rafael Garrigi.He meets his former lover here.Aware of her strengths, the femme fatale has one goal - to take revenge for the way she was once treated.

programme.title: Infinitely Polar Bear
programme.desc: 1970s, Boston.Cam Stuart (Mark Ruffalo) suffers from bipolar disorder.Due to his illness, he had to be hospitalized and lost his job.One day, his wife, nurse Maggie (Zoe Saldana), accepts a scholarship to New York University.The MBA degree obtained there will help her find a well-paid job, thanks to which she will provide for her family and take care of her children's education.While staying in another city, her husband has to take care of his daughters - adolescent Amelia (Imogene Wolodarsky) and Faith (Ashley Aufderheide).He faces an exceptionally difficult task.Girls are often embarrassed by the behavior of their father, who keeps coming up with various unusual ideas.However, they help him face everyday challenges.

programme.title: Caught Stealing
programme.desc: 1990s. Former baseball player Hank Thompson (Austin Butler) works as a bartender in a New York pub.He has a great girlfriend (Zoë Kravitz) and a championship-fighting team.His calm and orderly life changes when his neighbor Russ (Matt Smith) asks him to look after his cat for a few days.Then, out of nowhere, a gang of gangsters attacks Hank.Puerto Ricans, Russians and Jews are out to get him and he has no idea why.He will only find out what's going on if his wits and luck allow him to stay alive long enough.

programme.title: Lord Of The Flies
programme.desc: A film adaptation of William Golding's 1954 novel.A group of British boys on a desert island try to create fair rules.However, fear and power struggles lead to chaos and aggression.

programme.title: Euphoria
programme.desc: The further fate of a group of friends who left school behind and entered adulthood.The action moves forward several years.Rue (Zendaya Coleman) is no longer a lost teenager, but a person involved in the criminal world.He goes to interrogation in connection with smuggling drugs from Mexico.Cassie (Sydney Sweeney) and Maddy's (Alexa Demie) relationship has improved, but old wounds haven't healed at all.The first woman's relationship with Nate (Jacob Elordi) develops, but not towards a happy ending.The remaining characters confront their own choices, addiction and violence.They are looking for redemption and answers to the question about their place in the world.

programme.title: Sinners
programme.desc: The year is 1932. Twin brothers Smoke and Stack (double role of Michael B. Jordan), who have a difficult past, return from Chicago to their hometown in Mississippi.They try to escape from problems and a life of crime.They establish a music club for black people and hope for a new beginning.Their enemy, however, are dark, sinister forces that they must face.At stake is not only the lives of the brothers and their loved ones, but also their culture, history and memory.A dark cinema combining elements of action, horror and a musical drawing on the blues tradition.It is a story about an attempt at redemption and the fight against an invisible evil that symbolizes the weight of the past and past sins.

programme.title: Drag Me to Hell
programme.desc: Los Angeles.Christine Brown (Alison Lohman) works in a bank in the lending department and successfully climbs the career ladder.One day, an unusual client comes to her, an old and strange-looking gypsy named Sylvia Ganush (Lorna Raver).She asks for help in postponing the mortgage installment payment date.When Christine refuses to fulfill the order, the furious old woman curses her.He only has three days to remove the charm.After this time, the terrifying demon Lamia will take her to hell... An effective, suspenseful horror film, successfully combining elements of horror and black humor.The film was directed by Sam Raimi, author of the cult "Evil Dead", three parts of "Spider-Man" and "The Grudge" trilogy.

programme.title: Olivia and the Invisible Earthquake
programme.desc: Twelve-year-old Olivia, together with her younger brother Tim and her mother, must suddenly leave their current apartment and start all over again in a strange neighborhood.Wanting to protect Tim from fear and alleviate his sense of loss, the girl tells him that their move is part of the film in which he is the main character.This challenge to their imagination helps them come to terms with difficult reality.Over time, through new friendships, fun, and even a bit of magic, the siblings discover that they can truly take responsibility for their story.

programme.title: The Munsters
programme.desc: Transylvania.Dr. Henry Augustus Wolfgang (Richard Brake) and his not very bright assistant Floop (Jorge Garcia) want to create a perfect man from the dead bodies of geniuses of the past century.By mistake, instead of the brain of a great scientist, they implant the organ of his twin brother, a bad comedian, into the creature they created.This is how Herman Potwornicki (Jeff Daniel Phillips) is created.When Wolfgang decides to show it to the world on TV, he is devastated.However, the uncouth, joking giant attracts the attention of the unmarried and undead Lily (Sheri Moon), who is fed up with unsuccessful dates.The girl finds Herman and they quickly become a couple.The future son-in-law, although he gained fame and won Lily's heart, does not like her father, a vampire and a refined count (Daniel Roebuck).However, the lovers get married.Due to the intrigues of the count's cunning ex-wife, Zoya Krupp (Catherine Schell) and her assistant, the werewolf Lester (Tomas Boykin), they lose their palace and fortune.They decide to go to America, where Herman intends to conquer Hollywood.They start a new life in a ruined house in the suburbs.A colorful production referring to the series from the 1960s. Director Rob Zombie is his big fan.

programme.title: Bambi: A Tale Of Life In The Woods
programme.desc: Bambi the deer runs away from hunters and gets lost in the forest.The terrified toddler is found by a majestic deer - his father.Gradually, Bambi must grow up and learn the art of survival.

programme.title: Wunderschöner
programme.desc: 50-year-old Nadine (Anneke Kim Sarnau) does everything to look young.When she discovers that her husband (Godehard Giese) is cheating on her, she falls into depression.The couple's daughter Lilly (Emilia Packard) is interested in the classes lectured by feminist Vicky (Nora Tschirner).Enno, the narrator's boyfriend, participates in the project of her new colleague Trevor (Malick Bauer).He doesn't know that his beloved will soon lose her head for him.Julie (Emilia Schüle), a new TV production manager, suffers from loneliness.Her difficult relationship with her co-worker increases her doubts about herself.Sonja (Karoline Herfurth) and Milan (Friedrich Mücke) go to family therapy.When it comes to light that the man has a new partner, the woman starts dating.

programme.title: Eddie the Eagle
programme.desc: British ski jumper Michael 'Eddie' Edwards, although not successful, believes in his abilities.Thanks to the help of a charismatic coach, in 1988 he took part in the Olympics in Calgary.

programme.title: BlacKkKlansman
programme.desc: Early 1970s, Colorado Springs, Colorado.Ron Stallworth (John David Washington) becomes the first black police officer in the department.After encountering manifestations of racism, he asks to be transferred to undercover work.He decides to infiltrate the Ku Klux Klan, but for this he will need the help of an older, white colleague - Flip Zimmerman (Adam Driver).Ron calls representatives of a racist militia on the phone, and Flip meets with them directly.The police obtain information about the Klan's planned attack.Ron contacts David Duke (Topher Grace), the Grand Wizard of the Ku Klux Klan, by phone.Soon, Flip is accepted into the organization.Spike Lee's film won an Oscar for best adapted screenplay in 2019.Starring: versatile supporting actor Adam Driver ("What's Up, Davis?", "Silence") and former American football player John David Washington, Denzel Washington's son, nominated for a Golden Globe for this role.

credits.actor: Master Patrolman Andy Landers - Frederick Weller

programme.title: Druk
programme.desc: Denmark.Martin, Tommy, Peter and Nikolaj work as middle school teachers.They are burnt out and everyday life is taking its toll on them.During Nikolaj's birthday party, the men discuss the theory that humans are born with an alcohol deficit.Its small dose - only half a per mille in the blood - is supposed to increase their overall satisfaction.They decide to test it themselves and be excited every day.They quickly notice the positive effects - their family relationships improve, and they start to do better at work.Martin is finally able to communicate with his wife Anika and children, and the students finally listen to him with interest.Over time, however, it turns out that the initial dose is no longer enough for my friends and they start increasing it.They find that everything has its price.
